intro: Between April and July 2026, ZCyberNews covered eleven stories tagged openai, with Lazarus Group, TeamPCP, and Winos 4.0 appearing as the top threat actors. Coverage spanned technology, software development, artificial-intelligence, cloud services, and cybersecurity sectors, affecting Global and EU regions. The reporting included four high-severity and four medium-severity incidents, alongside two informational pieces. These articles documented activity across these distinct actors, with no specific CVEs named in the archive. The collection reflects a concentrated period of security developments involving OpenAI-related infrastructure and services, drawing attention from multiple independent threat groups.
